drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, au crayon, un petit croquis : une nappe en parallélogramme marquée $X$, traversée de trois traits dans le sens de sa hauteur et de courts traits épais dans l'autre sens, avec $K'$ près de son bord inférieur et $S$ à son coin supérieur droit ; à gauche, une verticale ponctuée de petites boucles descend jusqu'à un $S$.
drawings.kind: sheet (parallelogram) over a base line, with fibres
drawings.notes: Left margin, faint pencil. A tilted sheet (X): upper, right and lower sides in pencil, the left side a heavy stroke carrying a small cross; three lines across it, roughly parallel to its right side, the first starting below the upper side as on the page; eight short heavy strokes across these lines (on the upper side, in the middle and on the lower side); the letter X inside, K' near the lower side, S beside the upper right corner; from the lower left corner a loop going down to the left; at the far left a long vertical line in a brownish ink with small curls along it, ending at a letter S. Still differs: the pencil is faint and the sketch crowded; the heavy cross strokes are placed by eye and their number is a reading; the small curls on the vertical are drawn as short ticks; what the cross strokes stand for (the points over K_1, K_2?) is not settled. Nothing struck. The long vertical stroke to the right of the sketch borders the definition and is not drawn. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the left side had been closed as a pencil edge some 4 to 6 units right of the heavy stroke that forms it on the page, which was missing; the first cross line started on the upper side, 13 units too high; the loop at the lower left was too narrow; one cross stroke was 4 units off; corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
